title: Magnets and Magnetic Fields
summary: Magnetic materials, poles, attraction and repulsion, field lines and the compass.

ib.note: Magnetic fields and flux follow in MYP 4–5

objectives: I can identify magnetic and non-magnetic materials.
I can describe the poles of a magnet and the rules of attraction and repulsion.
I can describe the magnetic field of a bar magnet using a compass and iron filings.
misconceptions: A compass points to the geographic North Pole because it is attracted to it as a north pole.
